scope: 2014 dlp base game: English printed pp.12–21, all 20 base Place Tiles pp.22–23, and components p.24. Optional pregame Place Tile exclusion and expansions excluded.

checked_claims.claim: Component counts and goods distribution match: 104 Character Tiles, 90 goods (24/21/18/15/12), 16 Technology, 14 Citizens, 47 coins, 20 Places, 18 Hour Glass tiles, four bags/boards/merchants, 40 stations, 28 cubes, two reference cards and start token.

Setup correctly assigns four marked starting Followers to Market, five coins, merchant in Orleans, seven initial track markers, 13 board Citizens and one final award; Place stacks, Pilgrimage-first event stack and goods placement/removals are correct.
Two-/three-player neutral Follower removals (4/6 and 2/3 per profession group), random goods removals (12/6), and excluded route spaces (3+4/4) match.

All seven phases, 18-round duration, Pilgrimage timing, Census uniqueness and two-player exemption, draw allowance/capacity, simultaneous planning, passing, retained activations and follower return destinations are accurately described.

The ten player-board action costs match the printed board diagram: Farm House Boatman+Craftsman; Village Farmer+Boatman+Craftsman; University Farmer+Craftsman+Trader; Castle Farmer+Boatman+Trader; Monastery Scholar+Trader; Ship Farmer+Boatman+Knight; Wagon Farmer+Trader+Knight; Guildhall Farmer+Craftsman+Knight; Scriptorium Knight+Scholar; Town Hall any one/two eligible Followers.
Recruitment destinations, rewards, Trader category access, Craftsman Technology placement only after passing, track-end recruitment prohibition and fourth-Knight allowance exception match.
source_references: pp.16–17, Farm House, Village, University, Castle, Monastery

checked_claims.claim: One-connection movement, at-most-one route good, empty routes, Guildhall location/occupancy and Orleans exception match.
Town Hall permits one/two exact neutral professions, Deed rewards and last-space Citizen; marked Followers and substitutions cannot satisfy Deeds.
Monk substitution and Technology restrictions (first placed tile Farmer; later no Monk; one per Place; no single-Follower Place; permanent placement) match.

All 20 Place Tile costs were visually checked: Hayrick F; Cheese Factory F+F; Winery F+T; Wool Manufacturer B+T; Tailor Shop S+T; Shipping Line B; Brewery M; Windmill C+C; Library K+S; Pharmacy any one; Cellar M+S; Office S+S; Hospital B+S; Horse Wagon T+K; Laboratory S+C; Bathhouse F; Sacristy M; Herb Garden and School passive; Gunpowder Tower two any-Follower storage spaces.
source_references: pp.22–23, printed Place Tile illustrations (visually inspected)

checked_claims.claim: All 20 base Place Tile effects match, including Pharmacy 1–3 payment, original Bathhouse draw-three/choose-two and bag returns, Laboratory usual restrictions/self-placement, Sacristy phase-six use, School/Herb Garden substitution and Gunpowder Tower phase-three/planning/action timing and Deed restrictions.
source_references: pp.22–23, The Place Tiles in Detail

checked_claims.claim: Development coin/Citizen crossing rewards, Status changes, final unique station Citizen, goods/coin scoring, (built stations+Citizens) times Status and Development Track tiebreak match.
source_references: p.19, The Development Track and End of the Game and Scoring

checked_claims.claim: All six event effects and three-per-type counts match, including Harvest food types/destination/five-coin fallback, Taxes rounding, built-station Trading Day and Plague marked-Follower protection/no redraw/no track retreat.
Torture alternatives, per-missing-coin exchange, random neutral bag draw, Development retreat restriction and removal-from-game destination match.

Finite supplies/action prohibition, temporary coin shortage, bag inspection then shuffle, marked-Follower protection, phase-three recall in exchange for declined draws, payment destination and clockwise resolution match.
source_references: p.21, General Rules of the Game

assessment: No material source contradiction or important omission found within the assigned scope. The printed activation diagrams agree with both action tables. No excluded reader/question/key/grading material was consulted.
